messages.subject: Error in predict(my_fitted_model)
parts:
Hi, 

Thanks for an incredibly straightforward package

I fitted my model, and get the following error when trying to get the individual factor scores, using predict(myFit)

Error in VETA[[g]] %*% t(LAMBDA[[g]]) : non-conformable arguments

I removed NAs listwise and got rid of the is_female (a categorical variable), but it didn't help. 

Is there another obvious reason why it doesn't work?


I saw this other post, but couldn't find a solution either
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/lavaan/n3QBvx6YtXs

Here's a simplified version of my model, in case it helps
data<- myData ;
oneFactorModel<-"
G=~1.0*x1
G=~x2
G=~x3
G=~y
y ~ age
y ~ is_female
";
myFit<-lavaan(oneFactorModel, data=data);


Best, and thanks
Elisa
